note: (2026-11-24) ISO reference mass override used only with rp2_mpc_rt.py --human-shoulder 1 (goal1/data/iso_15066.json is not changed). ISO 15066 groups the shoulder with the trunk (40 kg); in the 19-segment human model the shoulder segment starts the arm chain, so the neighbouring upper-arm value (iso_15066.json left/right_upper_arm m_h_iso 3.0 kg) is used.
